name: Jubilee Mission Medical College and Research Institute
tagline: NABH‑accredited multi‑speciality teaching hospital and research centre
summary: Large private teaching hospital in Thrissur offering multi‑speciality tertiary care, undergraduate and postgraduate medical education, NABH and NABL accreditations, and extensive inpatient services.
description: Jubilee Mission Medical College & Research Institute is a private, Christian‑minority medical college, tertiary hospital and research centre located in the Jubilee Mission campus, Thrissur. The college began classes in 2003 and operates alongside Jubilee Mission Hospital.

It functions as a multi‑speciality referral hospital with accredited laboratory services and recognised quality systems (NABH, NABL and KUHS QAS A+). The institute combines patient care, medical education (MBBS, multiple PG and DM/DNB programmes) and clinical research.

Visitors and regional medical travellers find comprehensive departments and speciality units, an academic hospital environment with diagnostic services, and typical teaching‑hospital facilities such as specialty OP clinics, emergency services and in‑patient wards.

The institute emphasizes affordable, faith‑based care guided by its founding trust and serves patients from Thrissur district and neighbouring regions; confirm appointment and admissions details with the hospital before travel.
highlights: NABH‑accredited hospital with a NABH scope/certificate (certificate H‑2022‑0925).
KUHS QAS A+ accreditation for the college (listed by KUHS).
Undergraduate MBBS programme (150 annual seats) and multiple PG and super‑speciality programmes (DM, DNB, fellowships).
Large sanctioned inpatient capacity (NABH record: total sanctioned beds listed).
Located in central Thrissur (Jubilee Mission campus / Bishop Alappatt Road).

sections.heading: Background
body: Jubilee Mission Medical College & Research Institute is run by the Jubilee Mission Hospital Trust under the Archdiocese of Thrissur. Classes at the medical college commenced in 2003. The institute combines a teaching hospital, allied health institutes and research units on the Jubilee Mission campus.

sections.heading: Clinical services & departments
body: The hospital is a multi‑speciality tertiary centre with numerous departments (medicine, surgery, paediatrics, obstetrics & gynaecology, cardiology, neurology, oncology, nephrology, critical care, orthopaedics, ENT, ophthalmology and allied specialties). It lists more than 30 clinical and supportive departments on its site.

Laboratory and imaging services operate under NABL accreditation. The facility provides emergency care, specialty OP clinics, procedures and inpatient wards typical of a major teaching hospital; check the hospital website or contact the department for specialty clinic days and referral procedures.

sections.heading: Research, teaching & training
body: The college is affiliated to Kerala University of Health Sciences and runs an MBBS programme (150 seats) plus numerous postgraduate and super‑speciality courses including DM programmes and DNB/neurosurgery fellowships. The campus publishes academic calendars and quality reports for its allied institutes.

Research activity is embedded in departmental work and postgraduate theses; for specific research collaborations or visiting researcher arrangements contact the medical college research office directly.

sections.heading: Plan your visit
body: The campus is in central Thrissur (Bishop Alappatt Road / Jubilee Mission PO). For appointments call the hospital or the college enquiry numbers listed on the official site and confirm timings in advance — teaching hospitals can have differing OP schedules.

International or regional medical travellers should bring referral notes, previous medical records and insurance documents. Confirm admission procedures, registration, and billing/insurance empanelment before travel.

latest.text: Kerala University of Health Sciences (KUHS) QAS accreditation list shows Jubilee Mission Medical College & Research Institute with an A+ QAS accreditation entry dated 29‑04‑2025.
NABH certificate (H-2022-0925) records certification valid from April 09, 2025 through April 08, 2029 and lists total sanctioned beds in the NABH scope document.

visitorInfo.bestTime: Year‑round; hospital services operate throughout the year — book specialty appointments in advance.
visitorInfo.howToReach: Located in central Thrissur (Bishop Alappatt Road, Jubilee Mission PO). Reach by taxi or auto from Thrissur city bus stand and Thrissur Railway Station; the nearest major airport is Cochin/Cochin International Airport (COK). Confirm local transport options before travel.
etiquette: Call ahead to book specialty OP appointments or admissions; teaching hospitals often run separate OP and academic schedules.
Carry referral letters, past medical records and copies of ID and insurance; verify empanelment or cash/payment policies beforehand.
If travelling from outside Kerala, coordinate with the hospital enquiry/admissions office for bed availability and local accommodation options.
For research or academic visits, contact the college research or medical education department to arrange approvals and supervision.
